Commentary.Commentary: The target now is a big one but New Zealand do have a few batters who can hit the ball big. They need to bat out of their skins if they are to win this game. India on the other hand, have momentum on their side at the momentum and they will look to carry forward it in the field. Who will win the first game of the World Cup? Stay tuned to find out.

Kaur and Rodrigues took a few overs to get their eye in but once they were set, the bowlers were tonked to every part of the ground. A 134-run stand between the two with Rodrigues scoring a half ton. She though departed at the death but Kaur did not let the momentum slipped away. She continued the assault and got to a century and justified her decision to bat first.

An extraordinary batting performance from the Indian skipper has seen India post a massive total. They would have grabbed this with both hands if this was offered to them when they elected to bat. Also, they did not get to the best of starts. They lost three withing the Powerplay for not many. However, it was after that the carnage started.
No 200! A dot to end! Full and outside off, the batsman fails to put bat on ball. INDIA END ON 194!

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! End of Kaur and end of one of the best innings in a T20I World Cup game. Every player has walked up to her and congratulated her and she deserves every bit of it. A full ball outside off, Kaur goes after it but gets an outside edge to the keeper. India need a maximum of the last ball to get to 200. Will they?
Full and outside off, it is slapped through covers for a run.

100 for Harmanpreet Kaur. Take a bow, talk about leading from the front and she has done exactly that. She came out to bat when India were down and out and now she has taken her country close to the 200-run mark. She walks across and works it through square leg for a couple. Her teammates are on their feat giving her a standing ovation and she acknowledges the applause.
99 she moves onto! This is powered down to long off for a couple.
Slower ball on off, the batter opens the face of the bat and guides it towards short third man for a run.

SIX! Consecutive maximums and now 200 is possible! She uses her feet and it is right in her arc. Tonks it over mid-wicket for a maximum. A wicket but 15 from this over. 97 is what Kaur is on. She won't be on strike though.
SIX! WOW! This is some hitting. Outstanding. Goes down on one knee and slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket fence fora  huge one.
Hits it down to long on for a run.
Flatter and outside off, it turns back in. VK keeps it out.

OUT! STUMPED! End of a magnificent stand and a brilliant innings. Rodrigues walks off after doing her job. Watkin tosses it up outside off, Rodrigues comes down the track and tries to go across the line. She misses and the keeper does the rest. Can New Zealand now turn the momentum towards them?
Excellent running! This is hit down towards long on. They run the first one hard which creates the opportunity of a second and they take it.
Jess Watkin is back on.
SIX! That is another HUGE one! 17 from the over! Brilliant use of the feet, she gets under the length of the ball and then hits it with ease over the long off fence.
Flatter and outside off, guided towards point for a quick run.
Hits it down to long off for a single.
FOUR! The New Zealand bowlers have no answer to Kaur here. She goes down on one knee and sweeps it over the square leg fielder for a boundary.
Uses her feet again and lofts it over covers for a run.
FOUR! Smashed! Take that, says Rodrigues. Uses her feet and hits it hard past the bowler for a boundary. Again a boundary to start the over.
Amelia Kerr is on.
A dot to end but 15 runs from the over. Full and wide outside off, the batsman fails to jam it out.
FOUR! No one there and another boundary. Kaur goes down on one knee and sweeps it over the square leg fielder and into the fence. Picking her spots brilliantly. Consecutive boundaries.
FOUR! A gift but it still has to be put away! A high full toss, Kaur swings but gets a top edge. It goes over the short fine fielder and into the fence.
Through mid-wicket now but just a run.
This is now smashed back past the bowler for a couple. 50 up for Rodrigues as well. It has been a glorious, stylish and a very important knock by her.
FOUR! Early boundary, pressure on the bowler now. Short and on middle, JR dismisses it out of her sights and into the mid-wicket fence.
Jensen to have another go with the ball.

Flatter and on middle, Rodrigues tries to flick but the ball takes the leading edge and lobs towards the leg side. The batsmen go for a run, this could be tight but the bowler fails to collect the ball. 100-run stand up, a vital stand. The two have to continue and they hold the key if India want to reach 180.
In the air... but short! Kaur uses her feet and tries to go big. It goes off the inner half towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
SIX! That is huge! 14 from the over now! Comes down the track and hits it over the long off fence. This is carnage here.
FOUR! Now a boundary! This was finesse from Kaur. Short and outside off, she waits and then guides it through point for a boundary. 8 from the first three.
Flicks this through square leg and takes another two.
On the shorter side outside off, it stays a touch low. Kaur cuts it through point and takes two.
Leigh Kasperek is back.
Good length outside off, Kaur guides it towards short third man for a run. 26 from the last two overs.
Shortish and outside off, it is pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
On off, the batsman blocks it out.

Fifty for Kaur! First fifty of this year's World Cup and what a time to get it. India were in big trouble when she came out and she has led from the front. She taps the length ball towards point to get to that milestone.
FOUR! Clever, how clever was that! She gets to 49. Slower ball and it is outside off, Kaur waits for it and then guides it through backward point for a boundary.
Full and on off, it is driven square on the off side for a run.
Devine is back on.
FOUR! Huge over! 18 from it. Kaur comes down the track and whips it through mid-wicket. The fielder from long on runs to her right, dives and tries to stop it but fails to do so.
SIX! BANG! Kaur is in six-hitting more here. She uses her feet and tonks it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Works it to mid-wicket for a run.

SIX! It just about brushes the fingertips of Bates at long on. It will be harsh on her to call it a drop. Another full toss, Kaur lofts it towards long on. Bates there jumps and gets a fingertip to it but the ball crosses the ropes.
Another single and it brings up the 100 for India. It is eased down to long off for a run.
On the pads, this is worked around the corner for a run.
Amy Satterthwaite is on.
Tapped away gently on the off side for a quick single.
Rodrigues gives the charge to this tossed up ball and knocks it long on for a run.
FOUR! Full in length and outside off, Rodrigues goes a bit square on the off side. Drills this through cover-point and finds the fence.
Full, fast and darted around off, jammed out on the off side.
Drills this full ball towards cover-point and gets to the other end.
Kaur steps out of the track and as a result, yorks herself. Can only dig it out back to the bowler.
Amelia Kerr returns.
Short and wide outside off, cut down late to third man for a single. 10 off the over.

FOUR! One bounce and across the rope. Full and outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur puts this away. In the slot, so she lifts it over mid off for a boundary. The 50-run stand is up between these two as well.
Dishes out a low full toss outside off, Kaur can only play it back to the bowler.
Sprays it on leg, it keeps angling down, goes off the batter's pads and past the diving keeper. A leg bye is taken.
FOUR! That's a really nice shot. Full and right in the slot for Rodrigues. She leans ahead and lofts it cleanly over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fullish in length outside off, driven to covers for no run.
Lea Tahuhu is back into the attack.
Full on the stumps, Kaur looks to flick it away but gets a safe leading edge back in the bowler's direction.
Short, flat and around off, played back down the track off the back foot.
Slow and short, it is worked through mid-wicket. A single taken.
Kaur is down on the ground. Not sure why, she is see holding her stomach. The physio is out, India will hope it is nothing serious.
Now a couple, good batting this. Rodrigues comes down the track and lofts it over mid off. A brace taken.
On the shorter side, it is worked around the corner for a run.
Gives it a nice loop on middle, it is swept through square leg for a run.
Leigh Kasperek is back into the attack.

SIX! Second in the over and this is probably the momentum-changing over. Kaur dances down the track and lofts it over the long off fence. 16 from the over! 76 at the halfway mark. Can India get to 150? That could be match-winning on this track.
Slower through the air around off, it turns back in. JR tries to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls towards the leg side for a single.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Flatter and around off, Kaur plays it late through short third man for a couple.
SIX! Kaur has picked the bones out of that one. She is nimble on her feet and makes it into a high full toss. She hoicks it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Slower through the air on middle, it is hit back to the bowler.
Gives it air on off, it is kept out towards covers for a run. 8 from this over.
EDGE BUT SAFE! Kaur now uses her feet and tries to go downtown. She gets an outside edge to short third man.
Uses her feet again and strokes it through covers for a single.
Slower through the air on middle, Kaur drops it towards covers for a run.
Uses her feet again and takes it on the full, it is stroked through covers for a run.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Dances down the track, takes it on the full and strokes it through covers. No need to run for those.
Full and on middle, Kaur goes for the drive but gets an inside edge onto her boot. The non-striker wants a run but is sent back in time. The keeper has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Short and outside off, the batsman goes for the cut but misses.
On a length and outside off, it is guided towards backward point. There is some confusion between the two batsmen but they eventually take a run.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Good batting, rotates strike by tapping it towards point for a run.
FOUR! Welcome into the attack! A much-needed boundary for India. Rodrigues comes down the track and flicks it fine down the leg side. Ideal start to the over, they will now look to make it a big one.
Devine is into the attack now.
A full toss outside off, it is stroked through covers for a run. So a good first by Kerr.
Uses her feet and flicks it nicely in the gap of the deep mid-wicket region. A couple taken.
Now only a run as it is guided towards short third man.
Flatter and on off, it is punched back to the bowler. Three dots to begin with.
Uses her feet and strokes it back to the bowler.
Tossed up on off, kept out.
Amella Kerr is on.
Punched through covers for a run. A single to end the Powerplay and a good one for New Zealand. India are 41 for 3.
On the stumps kept out.
Harmanpreet Kaur strides out to bat.

OUT! In the air... taken! There goes no. 3 and not many teams win a game after losing three in the Powerplay. A low full toss on off, Hemalatha moves right across and goes for the sweep. She gets a top edge and it goes into the hands of. Tahuhu who takes an easy catch.
Brings out the slog sweep and hits it through mid-wicket for a couple.

OUCH! That has hit the umpire. He seems fine though but he certainly saves New Zealand some runs. Rodrigues comes down the track and smashes it back towards the bowler. She fails to get a hand to it and the ball hits the arm of the umpire and rolls towards long on.  A run taken.
Tosses it up on off, it is driven back to the bowler.
Leigh Kasperek is back on.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries to end the over! 13 from it. On a length and around off, DH strokes it on the up through covers.
FOUR! This is turning out to be a good over! The batsman uses her feet and thwacks it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Slower ball outside off, it is guided through point and a couple is taken. That was nicely played, clever batting.
Shuffles across and works it around the corner for a run.
A wild swing but the timing is nowhere close to the one she would have liked. It rolls towards wide mid on, a run taken.
Works it with the angle through mid-wicket for a run.
Jensen is now into the attack.
Very full on the pads, Hemalatha flicks it through mid-wicket and a brace is taken. A couple to end the over, a successful one for New Zealand.
Dayalan Hemalatha is the new batsman.

OUT! What a catch that is! My word, that is some grab. A short ball on middle, Mandhana pulls it right off the middle towards deep square leg. It is traveling like a rocket. Jensen there, positions herself, times her leap to perfection and then plucks it out of thin air. Mandhana walks back in disbelief and both the openers are back in the hut. India in trouble.
Down the leg side, Rodrigues swings but misses. The ball brushes her pads and the keeper does really well to dive to her left and save three for her time as a leg bye was taken.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Classy! Full and outside off, Rodrigues reaches out for it and strokes it through covers. No stopping those.
Short and wide outside off, JR goes for a cut but misses.

Another huge appeal! This looked close! The arm ball on off, it comes in with the angle. Mandhana tries to punches it through the off side with her bat and pad very close. A huge appeal follows but not given. A mid-pitch conference takes place but then they opt to review. Should have as it was pad first and also Hawk Eye shows three reds.
Flatter and outside off, Mandhana tries to guide it through point but gets beaten.
A low full toss on off, it is driven towards covers.
This one stays a touch low. It is outside off, Mandhana tries to punch but gets an under edge.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Mandhana guides it through point and brace results.
Works it with the turn towards mid-wicket. A single taken.
Leigh Kasperek is on.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground. They pick up a single. End of a very good first by Tahuhu. They needed this after going for runs in the first.
Good length on off, kept out.

Another appeal but not given! This is down the leg side, Rodrigues tries to flick but misses to get hit on the boot. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Going down leg. The batsmen run two leg byes as it goes down to fine leg.
A big appeal but not given! Down the leg side, JR tries to flick but there is a noise as the ball passes the bat. A huge appeal follows but not given. Must have been of the ball hitting the pad.
Goes for a yorker but ends up bowling a full toss, Rodrigues flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Jemimah Rodrigues is the new batsman.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Tahuhu strikes on her very first ball. A single and two boundaries is all Bhatia can manage. This is on a length and around middle, TB tries to flick but misses to get hit on her pads. The ball deflects onto the stumps. Tahuhu is ecstatic and New Zealand are up and running now.
Lea Tahuhu to bowl from the other end.
Flatter and outside off, Madhana tries to cut but chops it towards the keeper. A dot to end but an expensive start for New Zealand. India are off to a flier.
Now does the right thing by working it around the corner for a run.
Plays the sweep shot but it is straight to the fielder at short fine leg. Unlucky that, a little to the left or right, it would have been the third boundary of the over.

FOUR! Second boundary in the over! A hit-me ball. Short and down the leg side, Bhatia pulls it through backward square leg. The fielder in the deep runs to her right and puts in a dive but her effort goes in vain.
On the stumps again, it is worked towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! India are underway and that too with a boundary! First of this World Cup. This is on the stumps, Bhatia walks across and flicks it very fine on the leg side. A boundary. Ideal start for India.

Done and dusted with the national anthem. We are now all set for the action to begin. The New Zealand players make their way out to the middle. They are followed by the India openers, Smriti Mandhana and Taniya Bhatia. The latter will be on strike and she will face Jess Watkin. Here we go...
The two teams make their way out for their respective national anthems.
TOSS - India win the toss and they opt to bat first.

Hello and welcome to the coverage of the first game of the Womens T20I World Cup. It is India taking on New Zealand. First match of Group B. Two exciting teams and we can expect a cracking encounter. Both the teams will be eager to get the better of their opponent today. Who will come out on top? Stay tuned to find out.
